v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Benedíctus Dóminus * suscéptor meus et liberátor meus.
text.en: Blessed be the Lord * my support, and my deliverer.

text.la: Beátus pópulus * cuius Dóminus Deus eius.
text.en: Happy is that people * whose God is the Lord.

text.la: Magnus Dóminus * et laudábilis nimis: et magnitúdinis eius non est finis.
text.en: For the Lord is great * and exceedingly to be praised: His greatness has no end.

text.la: Fratres: Si linguis hóminum loquar, et Angelórum, caritátem autem non hábeam, factus sum velut æs sonans, aut cýmbalum tínniens.
text.en: Brothers: If I speak with the tongues of men, and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.

v.la: Vespertína orátio ascéndat ad te, Dómine.
v.en: Let the evening prayer ascend unto thee, O Lord.

r.la: Et descéndat super nos misericórdia tua.
r.en: And let there descend upon us thy mercy.

text.la: Pater fídei nostræ * Abraham summus, óbtulit holocáustum super altáre pro fílio.
text.en: The father of our faith, * the mighty Abraham, offered a burnt offering on the altar for his son.

text.la: Preces nostras, quǽsumus, Dómine, cleménter exáudi: atque, a peccatórum vínculis absolútos, ab omni nos adversitáte custódi.
text.en: O Lord, we beseech You, mercifully hear our prayers; loose us from the chains of our sins and keep us from all adversity.
